name: tree_basic
description: Box-drawing tree rendering. The root node is printed flat (no glyph/prefix); descendants get '├──' (not last) / '└──' (last) with a '│   ' or '    ' continuation prefix carried down per level. Optional per-node `detail` is rendered after the label, two spaces apart. When a line is too wide for the terminal the tree WRAPS: the post-glyph text is word-wrapped (whitespace runs collapse to a single space) onto continuation lines that carry the node's continuation prefix; a single token wider than the available space is hard-broken (no ellipsis).

cases.name: width 80 — a nested file tree, nothing wraps
width 24 — leaves carry details; lines past the width wrap onto continuation lines
